abstract: Maintains offshore acoustic inspection durations, trenching inspection schedules, and seabed hydrodynamic operating limits
system_message:
You are Marine survey operations manager (SURVOPS). The Marine survey operations manager (SURVOPS) oversees offshore acoustic inspection planning, cable trenching survey runtimes, and hydrodynamic limits governing vehicle operability.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: France·Maintains offshore acoustic inspection durations, trenching inspection schedules, and seabed hydrodynamic operating limits（MOBIL）
information_points.content:
SURVOPS-MOBIL-Y3F：In France, the Autonomous underwater vehicle bathymetric grid demonstrates a seabed bottom-current operability threshold of 2.2 kn in the Celtic Sea fault corridor, accompanied by a planned offshore acoustic inspection duration of 30 h between KP 42.0 and KP 58.0.
SURVOPS-MOBIL-YBP：Covering operations in France, the Deep-tow synthetic aperture sonar transect delivers a seabed bottom-current operability threshold of 3.0 kn across the Celtic Sea Continental Shelf fault corridor and entails a planned offshore acoustic inspection duration of 60 h along the KP 42.0 to KP 58.0 localization segment.
SURVOPS-MOBIL-L8V：For activities based in France, the Work-class ROV continuous acoustic tracker maintains a seabed bottom-current operability threshold of 2.5 kn across the Celtic Sea fault corridor and is scheduled for a planned offshore acoustic inspection duration of 45 h over the KP 42.0 to KP 58.0 segment.

information_points.title: United Kingdom·Maintains offshore acoustic inspection durations, trenching inspection schedules, and seabed hydrodynamic operating limits（HYDRO）
information_points.content:
SURVOPS-HYDRO-HO7：For United Kingdom operations, the Work-class ROV continuous acoustic tracker provides a seabed bottom-current operability threshold of 2.5 kn along the Celtic Sea fault corridor and requires a planned offshore acoustic inspection duration of 45 h for the cable segment between KP 42.0 and KP 58.0.
SURVOPS-HYDRO-CMB：In United Kingdom, the Autonomous underwater vehicle bathymetric grid exhibits a seabed bottom-current operability threshold of 2.2 kn under tidal stream conditions in the Celtic Sea fault corridor, with a planned offshore acoustic inspection duration of 30 h across KP 42.0 to KP 58.0.
SURVOPS-HYDRO-3GZ：For operations in United Kingdom, the Deep-tow synthetic aperture sonar transect maintains a seabed bottom-current operability threshold of 3.0 kn across the Celtic Sea Continental Shelf fault corridor and is scheduled for a planned offshore acoustic inspection duration of 45 h between kilometer-points KP 42.0 and KP 58.0.
